senses.exPt: Tentamos comprar verduras orgânicas quando podemos.

senses.def: a living thing, especially a very small one
senses.ex: Bacteria are tiny organisms that live almost everywhere.
senses.exPt: As bactérias são organismos minúsculos que vivem em quase todo lugar.

senses.def: a group of people who work together for a purpose, such as a company or charity
senses.ex: She works for an international organization.
senses.exPt: Ela trabalha para uma organização internacional.

senses.def: connected with organizing things or with the way an organization works
senses.ex: The job requires strong organizational skills.
senses.exPt: O trabalho exige boa capacidade de organização.

senses.def: to plan or arrange something
senses.ex: We're organizing a surprise party for her birthday.
senses.exPt: Estamos organizando uma festa surpresa para o aniversário dela.

senses.def: planning things well and keeping things in order
senses.ex: My sister is very organized and never forgets anything.
senses.exPt: Minha irmã é muito organizada e nunca esquece nada.

senses.def: a person who plans and arranges an event or activity
senses.ex: The organizers expect more than ten thousand people at the festival.
senses.exPt: Os organizadores esperam mais de dez mil pessoas no festival.

senses.def: the place or point where something begins
senses.ex: Nobody knows the origin of this tradition.
senses.exPt: Ninguém sabe a origem dessa tradição.

senses.def: existing at the beginning, before any changes
senses.ex: The original plan was to leave on Friday.
senses.exPt: O plano original era sair na sexta.

senses.def: the quality of being new, different and interesting
senses.ex: The judges praised the originality of her design.
senses.exPt: Os jurados elogiaram a originalidade do projeto dela.

senses.def: at the beginning, before any changes
senses.ex: The house was originally built as a school.
senses.exPt: A casa foi construída originalmente como uma escola.

senses.def: to start or come from a particular place or time
senses.ex: The game originated in China thousands of years ago.
senses.exPt: O jogo surgiu na China há milhares de anos.

senses.def: an object used to make a room, tree, etc. look attractive
senses.ex: The children hung ornaments on the Christmas tree.
senses.exPt: As crianças penduraram os enfeites na árvore de Natal.

senses.def: used for decoration rather than for a practical purpose
senses.ex: The garden is full of ornamental trees and flowers.
senses.exPt: O jardim é cheio de árvores e flores ornamentais.

senses.def: a child whose parents are dead
senses.ex: She became an orphan when she was five.
senses.exPt: Ela ficou órfã quando tinha cinco anos.

senses.def: the second of two, or a different one
senses.ex: Where is my other shoe?
senses.exPt: Cadê o meu outro sapato?

senses.def: used to say what will happen if something is not done
senses.ex: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the bus.
senses.exPt: Anda logo, senão a gente vai perder o ônibus.

senses.def: except for what has just been mentioned
senses.ex: The room was small, but otherwise it was fine.
senses.exPt: O quarto era pequeno, mas fora isso estava bom.

senses.def: a small animal with brown fur that swims and eats fish
senses.ex: We saw an otter swimming in the river this morning.
senses.exPt: Vimos uma lontra nadando no rio hoje de manhã.

senses.def: used to say what is the right or sensible thing to do
senses.ex: You ought to see a doctor about that cough.
senses.exPt: Você deveria ir ao médico por causa dessa tosse.

senses.def: a unit for measuring weight, about 28 grams
senses.ex: The recipe asks for four ounces of butter.
senses.exPt: A receita pede quatro onças de manteiga.

senses.def: a very small amount of a quality (an ounce of)
senses.ex: He doesn't have an ounce of common sense.
senses.exPt: Ele não tem um pingo de bom senso.

senses.def: belonging to the speaker and other people
senses.ex: Our house has a small garden.
senses.exPt: Nossa casa tem um jardim pequeno.

senses.def: the one that belongs to the speaker and other people
senses.ex: That red car over there is ours.
senses.exPt: Aquele carro vermelho ali é nosso.

senses.def: used to say that we did something without help
senses.ex: We built the house ourselves.
senses.exPt: Nós mesmos construímos a casa.

senses.def: used when we are both the subject and the object of a verb
senses.ex: We really enjoyed ourselves at the party.
senses.exPt: Nós nos divertimos muito na festa.

senses.def: away from the inside of a place, or away from home
senses.ex: It's a nice evening, so let's eat out tonight.
senses.exPt: A noite está boa, então vamos comer fora hoje.

senses.def: from inside something
senses.ex: He took his phone out of his pocket.
senses.exPt: Ele tirou o celular do bolso.

senses.def: having no more of something
senses.ex: We're out of milk, can you buy some?
senses.exPt: Estamos sem leite, você pode comprar?

senses.def: used to say how many from a larger group
senses.ex: Nine out of ten students passed the exam.
senses.exPt: Nove em cada dez alunos passaram na prova.

senses.def: old and no longer useful or correct
senses.ex: We were using an out-of-date map and got lost.
senses.exPt: Estávamos usando um mapa desatualizado e nos perdemos.

senses.def: no longer valid or safe to use, because a date has passed
senses.ex: I can't travel because my passport is out-of-date.
senses.exPt: Não posso viajar porque meu passaporte está vencido.

senses.def: the large dry area far from the cities in Australia
senses.ex: They spent a month driving across the outback.
senses.exPt: Eles passaram um mês dirigindo pelo interior da Austrália.

senses.def: the sudden start of a disease spreading among people
senses.ex: There has been an outbreak of flu at the school.
senses.exPt: Houve um surto de gripe na escola.

senses.def: the sudden start of something bad, such as a war
senses.ex: They left the country just before the outbreak of war.
senses.exPt: Eles saíram do país pouco antes do início da guerra.

senses.def: the final result of a process or event
senses.ex: We're still waiting for the outcome of the meeting.
senses.exPt: Ainda estamos esperando o resultado da reunião.

senses.def: to go faster or further than others in a race or competition
senses.ex: The young runner easily outdistanced the other competitors.
senses.exPt: O jovem corredor facilmente deixou para trás os outros competidores.

senses.def: to do better than someone else
senses.ex: She always tries to outdo her older sister.
senses.exPt: Ela sempre tenta superar a irmã mais velha.

senses.def: happening or used outside, not in a building
senses.ex: We love outdoor activities like hiking and cycling.
senses.exPt: Adoramos atividades ao ar livre, como trilhas e ciclismo.

senses.def: outside, not in a building
senses.ex: We ate outdoors because the weather was lovely.
senses.exPt: Comemos ao ar livre porque o tempo estava ótimo.

senses.def: on the outside or far from the centre
senses.ex: The outer walls of the house are made of stone.
senses.exPt: As paredes externas da casa são de pedra.

senses.def: a set of clothes worn together
senses.ex: She bought a new outfit for the wedding.
senses.exPt: Ela comprou uma roupa nova para o casamento.

senses.def: to grow too big for clothes, shoes, etc.
senses.ex: My son has outgrown all his clothes again.
senses.exPt: Todas as roupas do meu filho ficaram pequenas de novo.

senses.def: to stop having a habit or interest as you get older
senses.ex: Most children outgrow their fear of the dark.
senses.exPt: A maioria das crianças supera o medo do escuro.

senses.def: a short trip for pleasure, often with a group
senses.ex: The class went on an outing to the zoo.
senses.exPt: A turma fez um passeio ao zoológico.

senses.def: a criminal who is hiding from the police, especially in the past
senses.ex: The outlaw hid in the mountains for years.
senses.exPt: O fora da lei se escondeu nas montanhas durante anos.

senses.def: to make something illegal
senses.ex: The government outlawed smoking in bars and restaurants.
senses.exPt: O governo proibiu fumar em bares e restaurantes.

senses.def: a place in a wall where you connect electrical equipment
senses.ex: Is there an outlet near the bed to charge my phone?
senses.exPt: Tem uma tomada perto da cama para carregar meu celular?

senses.def: a way of expressing strong feelings or energy
senses.ex: Running is a good outlet for stress.
senses.exPt: Correr é uma boa válvula de escape para o estresse.

senses.def: a shop that sells a company's products
senses.ex: The company has over 200 outlets across the country.
senses.exPt: A empresa tem mais de 200 lojas em todo o país.

senses.def: to describe the main facts or ideas of something
senses.ex: The manager outlined his plans for next year.
senses.exPt: O gerente apresentou seus planos para o próximo ano.

senses.def: a short description of the main facts or ideas of something
senses.ex: Can you give me a brief outline of the story?
senses.exPt: Você pode me dar um breve resumo da história?

senses.def: the line that shows the shape of something
senses.ex: We could see the outline of the mountains in the dark.
senses.exPt: Dava para ver o contorno das montanhas no escuro.

senses.def: to live longer than someone else
senses.ex: In most countries, women usually outlive their husbands.
senses.exPt: Na maioria dos países, as mulheres geralmente vivem mais que os maridos.

senses.def: what is likely to happen in the future
senses.ex: The economic outlook for next year is not good.
senses.exPt: A perspectiva econômica para o ano que vem não é boa.

senses.def: your general attitude to life and the world
senses.ex: She has a very positive outlook on life.
senses.exPt: Ela tem uma visão muito positiva da vida.

senses.def: a person who gets hospital treatment but does not stay the night
senses.ex: She was treated as an outpatient and went home the same day.
senses.exPt: Ela foi atendida como paciente ambulatorial e voltou para casa no mesmo dia.

senses.def: the amount of something a person, machine or company produces
senses.ex: The factory has doubled its output this year.
senses.exPt: A fábrica dobrou a produção este ano.

senses.def: a strong feeling of anger and shock
senses.ex: The new tax caused public outrage.
senses.exPt: O novo imposto causou indignação pública.

senses.def: something that makes people very angry and shocked
senses.ex: These prices are an outrage!
senses.exPt: Esses preços são um absurdo!

senses.def: very shocking and unacceptable
senses.ex: The prices at that restaurant are outrageous.
senses.exPt: Os preços daquele restaurante são absurdos.

senses.def: the beginning of something
senses.ex: I told him at the outset that I couldn't stay long.
senses.exPt: Eu disse a ele logo no início que não podia ficar muito tempo.

senses.def: to be much better or more impressive than someone else
senses.ex: The young actor outshone all the famous stars in the film.
senses.exPt: O jovem ator ofuscou todas as estrelas famosas do filme.

senses.def: not inside a building
senses.ex: The kids are playing outside in the garden.
senses.exPt: As crianças estão brincando lá fora no quintal.

senses.def: a person who does not belong to a particular group or place
senses.ex: I always felt like an outsider at that school.
senses.exPt: Eu sempre me senti um estranho naquela escola.

senses.def: the parts of a town or city far from the centre
senses.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
senses.exPt: Eles moram nos arredores da cidade.

senses.def: extremely good; much better than usual
senses.ex: She did an outstanding job on the project.
senses.exPt: Ela fez um trabalho excelente no projeto.

senses.def: not yet paid, done or solved
senses.ex: You still have some outstanding bills to pay.
senses.exPt: Você ainda tem algumas contas pendentes para pagar.

senses.def: that other people can see, on the outside
senses.ex: She showed no outward sign of being nervous.
senses.exPt: Ela não demonstrou nenhum sinal aparente de nervosismo.

senses.def: going away from home, not coming back
senses.ex: The outward flight leaves at six in the morning.
senses.exPt: O voo de ida sai às seis da manhã.

senses.def: in the way someone or something seems, not how they really are
senses.ex: Outwardly she seemed calm, but she was very nervous.
senses.exPt: Por fora ela parecia calma, mas estava muito nervosa.

senses.def: to be more important or valuable than something else
senses.ex: The benefits of the plan outweigh the risks.
senses.exPt: Os benefícios do plano superam os riscos.

senses.def: shaped like an egg
senses.ex: We sat around a large oval table in the dining room.
senses.exPt: Nós nos sentamos em volta de uma grande mesa oval na sala de jantar.

senses.def: the part of a cooker, shaped like a box, for baking or roasting food
senses.ex: Put the chicken in the oven for an hour.
senses.exPt: Coloque o frango no forno por uma hora.

senses.def: above or across something
senses.ex: There's an old bridge over the river.
senses.exPt: Tem uma ponte velha sobre o rio.

senses.def: more than a number or amount
senses.ex: Over a hundred people came to the party.
senses.exPt: Mais de cem pessoas vieram à festa.

senses.def: considering everything together
senses.ex: There were a few problems, but overall it was a good trip.
senses.exPt: Teve alguns problemas, mas no geral foi uma boa viagem.

senses.def: including everything
senses.ex: The overall cost of the project was higher than expected.
senses.exPt: O custo total do projeto foi maior do que o esperado.

senses.def: a piece of clothing worn over other clothes to keep them clean
senses.ex: The mechanic wiped his hands on his oily overalls.
senses.exPt: O mecânico limpou as mãos no macacão sujo de óleo.

senses.def: over the side of a boat into the water
senses.ex: One of the sailors fell overboard during the storm.
senses.exPt: Um dos marinheiros caiu ao mar durante a tempestade.

senses.def: in 'go overboard': to do something too much
senses.ex: Don't go overboard with the decorations for the party.
senses.exPt: Não exagere na decoração da festa.

senses.def: to sell more tickets or rooms than are available
senses.ex: The airline overbooked the flight, so some passengers couldn't board.
senses.exPt: A companhia aérea fez overbooking no voo, e alguns passageiros não conseguiram embarcar.

senses.def: a long warm coat worn over other clothes
senses.ex: He put on his heavy overcoat and went out into the snow.
senses.exPt: Ele vestiu o sobretudo grosso e saiu na neve.

senses.def: to succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty
senses.ex: She finally overcame her fear of flying.
senses.exPt: Ela finalmente superou o medo de voar.

senses.def: money a bank lets you spend when your account is empty
senses.ex: I had to use my overdraft to pay the rent this month.
senses.exPt: Tive que usar o cheque especial para pagar o aluguel este mês.

senses.def: to give something more importance than it deserves
senses.ex: I think the report overemphasizes the risks of the plan.
senses.exPt: Acho que o relatório enfatiza demais os riscos do plano.

senses.def: to think something is bigger, better or more than it really is
senses.ex: We overestimated how much food people would eat.
senses.exPt: Superestimamos a quantidade de comida que as pessoas iam comer.

senses.def: to hear what people are saying without them knowing
senses.ex: I overheard my parents talking about my birthday present.
senses.exPt: Eu ouvi sem querer meus pais falando do meu presente de aniversário.

senses.def: extremely happy
senses.ex: They were overjoyed when their daughter was born.
senses.exPt: Eles ficaram radiantes quando a filha nasceu.

senses.def: the amount by which two things or activities cover the same area
senses.ex: There's a lot of overlap between the two courses.
senses.exPt: Há muita sobreposição entre os dois cursos.

senses.def: to happen at the same time as something else, partly or fully
senses.ex: The two meetings overlap, so I can't go to both.
senses.exPt: As duas reuniões coincidem, então não posso ir às duas.

senses.def: to fail to notice or think about something
senses.ex: It's easy to overlook small mistakes when you're tired.
senses.exPt: É fácil deixar passar pequenos erros quando você está cansado.

senses.def: to have a view of a place from above
senses.ex: Our hotel room overlooked the sea.
senses.exPt: Nosso quarto de hotel dava para o mar.

senses.def: too; more than is reasonable
senses.ex: I think you're being overly optimistic about the plan.
senses.exPt: Acho que você está sendo otimista demais em relação ao plano.

senses.def: during the night
senses.ex: It rained heavily overnight, so the roads are wet.
senses.exPt: Choveu muito durante a noite, então as ruas estão molhadas.

senses.def: very suddenly or quickly
senses.ex: She became famous overnight.
senses.exPt: Ela ficou famosa da noite para o dia.

senses.def: travelling or happening during the night
senses.ex: We took the overnight train to the capital.
senses.exPt: Pegamos o trem noturno para a capital.

senses.def: in or to a foreign country, especially across the sea
senses.ex: She wants to study overseas next year.
senses.exPt: Ela quer estudar no exterior no ano que vem.

senses.def: to watch and manage a job or activity to make sure it is done well
senses.ex: She oversees a team of twenty engineers.
senses.exPt: Ela supervisiona uma equipe de vinte engenheiros.

senses.def: a person or organization in charge of watching over work or workers
senses.ex: The overseer checked the workers' progress every hour.
senses.exPt: O supervisor verificava o andamento dos trabalhadores a cada hora.

senses.def: to make someone or something seem less important or less happy
senses.ex: She always felt overshadowed by her older sister.
senses.exPt: Ela sempre se sentiu ofuscada pela irmã mais velha.

senses.def: bigger than the usual size
senses.ex: She wore an oversize sweatshirt with her jeans.
senses.exPt: Ela usava um moletom largo com a calça jeans.

senses.def: to go beyond what is allowed or acceptable
senses.ex: I think you overstepped the mark with that joke.
senses.exPt: Acho que você passou dos limites com aquela piada.

senses.def: to go past a vehicle or person moving in the same direction
senses.ex: It's dangerous to overtake on a bend.
senses.exPt: É perigoso ultrapassar numa curva.

senses.def: to remove a leader or government from power by force
senses.ex: The army tried to overthrow the government.
senses.exPt: O exército tentou derrubar o governo.

senses.def: after the usual hours of work
senses.ex: She often works overtime to pay her bills.
senses.exPt: Ela costuma fazer hora extra para pagar as contas.

senses.def: extra time added to the end of a game when the scores are equal (American English)
senses.ex: The game went into overtime after a late goal.
senses.exPt: O jogo foi para a prorrogação depois de um gol no fim.

senses.def: to turn over so that the top is at the bottom
senses.ex: The truck overturned on the motorway this morning.
senses.exPt: O caminhão capotou na rodovia hoje de manhã.

senses.def: to officially change a legal decision
senses.ex: The higher court overturned the decision.
senses.exPt: O tribunal superior anulou a decisão.

senses.def: heavier than is healthy
senses.ex: The doctor said I was a little overweight.
senses.exPt: O médico disse que eu estava um pouco acima do peso.

senses.def: to give someone too much work or too many problems
senses.ex: I was overwhelmed by all the work this week.
senses.exPt: Fiquei sobrecarregado com tanto trabalho esta semana.

senses.def: to make someone feel a very strong emotion
senses.ex: She was overwhelmed by the kindness of strangers.
senses.exPt: Ela ficou emocionada com a gentileza de desconhecidos.

senses.def: very great or very large in amount
senses.ex: The new film was an overwhelming success.
senses.exPt: O novo filme foi um sucesso esmagador.

senses.def: so strong or difficult that you cannot deal with it easily
senses.ex: Starting a new job can feel overwhelming at first.
senses.exPt: Começar num emprego novo pode ser avassalador no início.

senses.def: too much work
senses.ex: The doctor said his illness was caused by overwork.
senses.exPt: O médico disse que a doença dele foi causada por excesso de trabalho.

senses.def: a sound you make when you suddenly feel pain
senses.ex: Ow! You're standing on my foot!
senses.exPt: Ai! Você está pisando no meu pé!

senses.def: to need to pay back money that someone lent you
senses.ex: I still owe you twenty dollars.
senses.exPt: Eu ainda te devo vinte dólares.

senses.def: owing to: because of
senses.ex: The flight was delayed owing to technical problems.
senses.exPt: O voo atrasou devido a problemas técnicos.

senses.def: because of
senses.ex: The match was cancelled owing to bad weather.
senses.exPt: O jogo foi cancelado devido ao mau tempo.

senses.def: a bird with large eyes that hunts at night
senses.ex: We heard an owl in the woods last night.
senses.exPt: Ouvimos uma coruja no bosque ontem à noite.

senses.def: belonging to a particular person and no one else
senses.ex: I want my own room.
senses.exPt: Eu quero o meu próprio quarto.

senses.def: a person who has something that belongs to them
senses.ex: The owner of the restaurant is very friendly.
senses.exPt: O dono do restaurante é muito simpático.

senses.def: a large male cow used for pulling things on a farm
senses.ex: The farmer used an ox to pull the cart.
senses.exPt: O fazendeiro usava um boi para puxar a carroça.

senses.def: a gas in the air that people and animals need to live
senses.ex: Plants produce oxygen during the day.
senses.exPt: As plantas produzem oxigênio durante o dia.

senses.def: a gas high above the Earth that protects it from the sun's harmful rays
senses.ex: Some chemicals damage the ozone layer.
senses.exPt: Alguns produtos químicos danificam a camada de ozônio.
